dispositions.status: safety behavior retained/superseded, not identical preflight API
dispositions.former: Node-specific STRICT adds missing/type issues and raises; WARN returns bad types with issues. Basic coercible types accepted. Integration validates processed per-node inputs before execute; skips if result falsey. Standalone flat path distributes without checking type/required.
dispositions.current: Workflow.validate checks missing required inputs against config/connections/processed overrides; Node.execute always calls validate_inputs and _validate_resolved_parameters, including connection_validation=off. Coercible str7 becomes int7; missing and nonconvertible int rejected.
dispositions.limits: Do not claim equal timing: archival preflight could reject supplied downstream bad values before any node executes; current per-node type validation happens at execution.

dispositions.status: partially superseded; runtime-wide strict policy/report API remains unlanded archival capability
dispositions.former: STRICT rejects undeclared input; WARN emits structured issue, permits kwargs nodes, otherwise filters. Runtime parameter_validation controls off/warn/strict/debug. All issue classes become errors in STRICT, including normal config overrides.
dispositions.current: Base Node logs/drop unknown by default; _strict_unknown_params=True rejects unknown. Explicit special names and underscore inputs exempt. Current LocalRuntime does not accept parameter_validation keyword. Constructor rejects unexpected keyword rather than silently treating connection_validation as this policy.
dispositions.recommendation: Do not restore old implementation wholesale. If runtime-wide policy is still desired, treat as an explicit feature with precedence-aware shared node validation and required tests; not proven required by current specs.

dispositions.status: actual archived behavior retained; current spec wording divergence remains explicit
dispositions.former: Standalone validator distributes flat names to ALL accepting nodes; LocalRuntime first normalizes via existing injector then validates processed per-node dictionary.
dispositions.current: LocalRuntime._separate_parameter_formats distinguishes recognized node+dict vs flat. _process_workflow_parameters uses WorkflowParameterInjector._get_all_nodes, merges per-node overrides above flat. Actual two-node linked workflow: flat7 gives root7/downstream7; per-node2/3 preserved; mixedflat7/downstream3 preserves downstream3.
dispositions.open: core-runtime.md says injected into root nodes while actual implementation injects all accepting nodes. This is not an archive-only missing implementation. Existing code comments explicitly intend all-node injection; bounded preferred correction is clarify spec with actual scoped behavior rather than blindly restrict runtime, pending parent disposition. No edits made.

overall: PARTIALLY_SUPERSEDED_WITH_NAMED_UNLANDED_POLICY_AND_SPEC_DIVERGENCE; not a blanket landed-equivalent claim; no demonstrated loss of required/type safety or flat/per-node mechanics.
